title: Remove unconditional ULA routing from the Rust gateway native mesh profile
description: P2 protocol correctness: resolved LICHEN addressing permits link-local fe80::/64 and native 0200::/8 key-derived /128 addresses; ULA is explicitly not used. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs is_local_mesh nevertheless treats every fd00::/8 destination as local and mesh_to_mesh forwards/compresses it without any RPL route lookup. This can misroute arbitrary ULA traffic onto the LoRa mesh and bypass the native-address/DAO admission invariant. Restrict local forwarding to link-local control and admitted native /128 RPL routes (plus any separately specified profile), and replace ULA-positive end-to-end tests with canonical native address vectors.
